name: @tangen/studio-schema
description: The canonical Tangen Studio contract - page/block/component schema, style values, style properties, tokens and breakpoints. Depends on nothing: every other Studio package reads this, so it can never depend upward.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json
